about: A made-up grid of values under number formats, with the text Excel showed for each cell (Range.Text), read in a private hidden Excel (Microsoft 365, en-US separators). Columns were 60 or 120 characters wide, except negative_dates_and_times, read at the standard width. Regenerate by reading Range.Text in Excel again for the same cells, never by hand.
